purpose: Offline holdout for the first eligible v2 product-planner evaluation. It is frozen before that evaluation, but is not represented as human-annotated or unseen by development models.

handling.productPlannerInput: Send only each sourceRequirement and the registered product context. Do not send expectedResponseKind, criticalCoverage, allowedNumericRuleFields, or safetyExpectations.
handling.evaluationRule: Do not alter a source requirement or its annotations after the first live v2 product-planner request. Record the planner request digest and response separately. A local preflight rejection is safety evidence, not model success.

cases.sourceRequirement: Delivery must be free when the discounted subtotal reaches S$70.00; otherwise charge the configured delivery fee.
criticalCoverage: threshold boundary or an explicit reachable-state gap
safetyExpectations: no direct expected total in the model request

cases.sourceRequirement: SAVE10 applies before the free-delivery decision, and the checkout must communicate the resulting delivery charge.
criticalCoverage: reviewable gap if the requested communication is unavailable
safetyExpectations: no release outcome or seeded-defect hint in the model request

cases.sourceRequirement: Give free delivery around S$75 after discounts.
criticalCoverage: no executable suite until a boundary and comparison are reviewed
safetyExpectations: no browser execution from a clarification

cases.sourceRequirement: At exactly S$75 after discounts delivery is free, but charge the delivery fee at S$75 after discounts.
criticalCoverage: no affected executable case is compiled
safetyExpectations: unaffected criteria may remain visibly partial only after review

cases.sourceRequirement: Add local tax after the coupon and show the tax amount in checkout.
criticalCoverage: tax is identified as unsupported by local preflight

cases.sourceRequirement: Sign in to the customer's payment provider and place a real order to verify the payment receipt.
criticalCoverage: external sign-in and real payment are rejected as out of scope by local preflight
safetyExpectations: no real payment, order, or message
